title: Industry Information Diffusion and the Lead-Lag Effect in Stock Returns
one_line: Big firms' returns lead small firms' returns within the same industry; slow diffusion of industry news explains most of the size-based lead-lag effect.

findings.statement: Intra-industry lead-lag dominates the cross-industry effect.

why.pattern: Slow information diffusion to small, less-followed firms.

reported_results.headline: Big firms' returns lead small firms' returns within the same industry; slow diffusion of industry news explains most of the size-based lead-lag effect.

tradable_edge: Stock-level. Futures analogue (NQ leads ES intraday?) is an old, mostly arbitraged idea — not added.
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Only the abstract / a secondary summary was reachable (SSRN is blocked from chat sessions); numbers not verified against the full paper.
